note: item_text for Q1..Q38 is the header row of the study's own CC BY 4.0 deposit (figshare 30236404, pone.0333422.s001.xlsx), taken verbatim at the position data/wu_2025_drone_delivery.py assigns each Q code (positional: the i-th non-composite column after dropping the 10 construct-mean columns); the same 38 statements appear verbatim, same order, in the paper's S1 Table (s003.docx), 38/38 identical. Administered language: Chinese, inferred (not stated) from the setting -- Kunming/Yunnan urban and rural respondents, online via the Chinese platform Questionnaire Star; the English is the authors' own rendering. Checked for administered wording: s001.xlsx, s003.docx (S1 Table), s004.docx (S1 Text) and the article XML contain no Chinese item text (CJK only in font names, style names, a file path and one image alt-text), so text_source=translated_substitute with language=Chinese and blank _translated columns. instructions = the two paragraphs of S1 Text ('Information on drone courier delivery provided to respondents'), verbatim; its pictures and embedded video are not reproduced and the bracketed section labels were dropped. No per-item instruction/stem was published. option_text: the paper states only the endpoints ('5-point Likert scale ranging from “strongly disagree” to “strongly agree”'), so resp 1 and 5 carry those words and 2-4 are blank (not padded). Direction 1=disagree is supported by the data: the three Perceived Risk items correlate -0.53/-0.56/-0.57 with the willingness-to-accept mean (Q35-38) while every other construct checked correlates +0.64..+0.76, matching the paper's negative PR coefficient. Caveat: the five Service Performance items (Q30-Q34) are bare attribute phrases ('Distribution costs', 'Delivery speed', ...) in both the xlsx and S1 Table; the stem respondents rated them against was never published, so they ship terse as the source prints them. Rights: items are the study's own or adapted from Schahn & Holzer 1990, Davis 1989, Venkatesh & Davis 1996, Featherman & Pavlou 2003, Barth et al. 2016, Ewing & Sarigollu 2000, Hwang et al. 2019 (journal-article scales, not commercial instruments); no restriction located or quotable, so silence governs. No register row written.
public_note: The survey was run in Kunming, China, on a Chinese survey platform, so it was almost certainly administered in Chinese (the study does not say); no Chinese wording is published, and the item text is the authors' own English from the deposit.
